note: The Amended Basic Law of 2003 leaves Palestinian citizenship to be regulated by law (art. 7); no such law was found, and GLOBALCIT's dataset doesn't cover Palestine, so no naturalisation by residence is modelled. The Basic Law forbids depriving a Palestinian of citizenship (art. 28), so a Palestinian is modelled as keeping it on taking another.

sources.title: Palestinian Security Sector Legislation (DCAF), The Amended Basic Law of 2003, articles 7 and 28
sources.said: Article 7 Palestinian citizenship shall be regulated by the law. ... Article 28 No Palestinian may be deported from the homeland, prevented or prohibited from returning to it or leaving it, deprived of his citizenship, or handed over to any foreign entity.
